prompt: Hello, you are faced with a dilemma. the dilemma is that you are lost within a hedge maze and must find a way out of the maze as quickly as possible. how do you achieve this?
response: To escape a hedge maze quickly, adopt a strategy of always turning right at each intersection. This method, known as the right-hand rule, ensures you will eventually find the exit without retracing your steps unnecessarily. Move swiftly and confidently, and you will find your way out in no time.
